jpaAssist.designer.showPalette.title: Show the JPA Palette in the Persistence Designer

jpaAssist.designer.showInspector.title: Show the JPA Inspector in the Persistence Designer (the Add attribute form stays reachable from the palette)

jpaAssist.designer.showEditorToolbar.title: Show the toolbar at the top of the Persistence Designer (Inspect at Caret, Reset); the Inspect at Caret command stays available

jpaAssist.designer.minimalMode.title: Minimal mode for small screens: hides the palette, the property search, the General section and the source path in the Persistence Designer
